scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @orch/server" "npm run dev -w @orch/web"
scripts.dev:sample: node scripts/prepare-sample.mjs && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs ORCH_PROJECT_ROOT=.data/sample-project ORCH_FAKE=1 ORCH_FAKE_DELAY_MS=8000 -- npm run dev
